scoring_notes: NONE/CLARIFY are valid primary decisions and have zero selected-skill pack.
Model-provided claims of no execution do not prove isolation; consumer admission must establish it.
Context/cost missing or incomparable => inconclusive, not zero.
Routing accuracy does not prove user-task outcome quality; tasks are forbidden in this study.
A real native skill outside the fixture catalog is catalog drift, not proof that the skill is globally fabricated.
No native call budget is opened while consumer admission fails.
Editable negative examples belong only to routing-treatment guidance. Battery and oracle remain frozen; an approved oracle correction requires a new version, never retroactive rescoring.

authority_tiers.none: No concrete task target/authority established; clarification only.
authority_tiers.advisory: Response-only explanation, advice or proposed/rewritten text; no file/system change.
authority_tiers.read_only: Inspect supplied or authorized records and return findings; no source/artifact mutation.
authority_tiers.local_artifact: An isolated local output artifact may be requested by the scenario; no upload or external publication.
authority_tiers.local_edit: Only the identified local files/target may be changed in the scenario; no commit, push, external write or destructive expansion.
